     - Match MAIN product title and author, not related items or review text.
     - Title without subtitle is normal, not abridged edition.
     - Single volume is NOT a whole series.
     - Ratings must be explicitly labelled ratings or global ratings, not reviews.
     - Reference pages require explicit inclusive bibliographical range; never infer zero or one from presence alone.
     - Print-page counts must identify a print edition, not Kindle or audio.
     - Return strict JSON only.
     - Check exact identity, numeric evidence and scope.
     - A named lead author suffices when other contributors are omitted.
     - Do not invent identity mismatches from punctuation or subtitles.
